fields.description: City Walk Northline is a low-rise apartment collection with one- to three-bedroom layouts. Northline 1 has 114 homes; Northline 2’s two buildings contain 190. The connected podium and open-air leisure areas give the two parts different site arrangements within the wider City Walk neighbourhood.

overview: The official one-bedroom example has a balcony and separate powder room. The larger two- and three-bedroom examples add maid accommodation and substantial outdoor space; their total areas are examples, not category minima.
